answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 21059 Country: India Title: I want to know that I can sand Quran's Aayats and Hadith by SMS? Question: Assalam I am Mohd Shuaib. I want to know that I can sand Quran's Aayats and Hadith by SMS? Answer ID: 21059 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 427/427/M=1431) Sending Quranic verses and hadith through mobile SMS is against the etiquette and respect. One should avoid it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
